text:
```artifact
Decision Table for Battery Alarm Logic

Conditions:
1. Battery Presence (Present/Not Present)
2. Chargeability (Chargeable/Not Chargeable)
3. Battery ETA (>=30 min, <30 min, <10 min)

Actions:
- Low Battery Alarm (Low Priority)
- Critically Low Battery Alarm (High Priority)
- Battery Failure Alarm

| Battery Presence | Chargeability | Battery ETA | Low Battery Alarm | Critically Low Battery Alarm | Battery Failure Alarm |
|------------------|---------------|-------------|-------------------|-----------------------------|-----------------------|
| Present          | Chargeable    | >=30 min    | No                | No                          | No                    |
| Present          | Chargeable    | <30 min     | Yes (Low)         | No                          | No                    |
| Present          | Chargeable    | <10 min     | Yes (Low)         | Yes (High)                 | No                    |
| Present          | Not Chargeable| Any         | Yes (Low)         | Yes (High)                 | Yes                   |
| Not Present      | Any           | Any         | No                | No                          | Yes                   |

```
